ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the peduncle base and specific focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white cluster at the inferior central peduncle junction. Set of four distinct, parallel diagonal white linear streaks located on the distal third of the left lobe. Sparse, small white focal spots distributed across the mid-superior region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 110 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire margin. Notable irregular indentation on the left lobe trailing edge approximately 30% distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the superior margin of both lobes, terminating in an upward-curving distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white and grey pixels localized on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of prominent, roughly parallel white diagonal scratches on the ventral-left lobe. Fine vertical linear disruptions on the upper-central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe. Heavy calcified-looking encrustations on the lateral tips of both lobes.
